name: inb_p
description: inb_p performs a byte-width input from the specified I/O port and pauses until the operation completes. It is used for low-level port input operations and is primarily intended for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port address to read from

return_value.success: Returns the unsigned char value read from the port
return_value.failure: Causes a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

bugs: Requires compilation with optimization flags like -O or -O2, as functions are defined as inline macros that may cause unresolved references without optimization. Additionally, these functions are hardware-specific and may behave differently across systems.
